name: Kestrin of the Riven Marches
role: Coliseum champion, the HARM cell — Marcher forms, and a clean stop when it is over
knowledge: Where a fighter's old injury is, from how they stand
wants: To be read as accurately as she reads
fears: ⚠️ A bout that becomes about blood. ⛔ She salutes and she stops, and a crowd that wants otherwise is the thing she cannot control.
appearance: Lean and squared-off, forearms scarred to the elbow, and she salutes before every exchange whether or not it is returned.
voiceHints: Formal in the ring and plain out of it. She names what she saw and does not soften it.

reactsToReputation.hesitant: ⚠️ punishes it, and says why afterwards

abilities.why: ⛔ 'she has read your stance since you walked out'
`punishes-hesitation` — the opening made from a pause
⚠️ 'they are not here for blood' — she ends it without ending you

physicality: ADULT. Lean, hard-used, forty. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she salutes an opponent who has not saluted back, every time, and it never reads as condescension.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ Formal until she is not. ⛔ She will not discuss the old injury she strikes at in others.
_authoredWhy: ⛑ AUTHORED 2026-09-07. ⛔ THE EIGHT COLISEUM CHAMPIONS WERE NOT NPCs — a name, a threat integer and four tactic tags inside an encounter file, and no sheet anywhere. ⚠️ CCode's matrix measured the consequence: 'every function any opponent can declare, in the whole game: strike, shield', and the win rate correlated with THREAT at −0.95 — ⛔ because threat was nearly the only authored number that varied. ⚑ THE EIGHT CELLS EXIST TO PROVE EVERY CONTRIBUTION FAMILY CAN WIN A FIGHT. They cannot prove it while every champion fights identically. ⚠️ Crafts are drawn from the encounter's OWN prose and tactic tags — nothing invented.
questSeeds: She will fight you properly if you salute, and afterwards she will tell you exactly what she saw — including the old injury you did not know you were guarding.
⚠️ The crowd wants blood and the forms forbid it. She is losing that argument slowly, and she has not asked anyone for help with it.
_questSeedsWhy: ⚑ SNG-167 §2 — an errand this person would ASK for, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears`. ⚠️ Authored with the champion because the ratchet caught eight new people carrying a want and no seed, which is exactly what it is for. ⛔ A coliseum champion is not only an opponent — 'the memorable arcs start with someone'.
_vocationWhy: ⛔ `vocation` IS AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED, and the attempt to derive it is the reason. ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-08: clustering 40 authored people by their crafts' verb families put SEVENTEEN OF FORTY in KEEPER and ZERO in EDGE — with KESTRIN, THE COLISEUM'S HARM CHAMPION, IN THE KEEPER COLUMN. ⛑ Rank-weighting did not fix it: she reads KEEPER 24 / READER 23 / EDGE 21, essentially flat. ⚑ THE CAUSE IS CLEAN: every capable person carries defensive and perceptive crafts, so verb counts measure COMPETENCE, not PURPOSE. ⛔ A VOCATION IS WHAT A PERSON IS FOR, and that is a judgement — the same shape as `tier`, which a regex also cannot mint. ⬜ `docs/VOCATIONS.md` holds the eight and what each does when a fight starts. ⚑ HERE: ⛑ THE HARM CELL, and the derivation put her in KEEPER. ⚠️ She fights under Marcher forms and 'they are not here for blood' — a class, not a temperament.
